statement: SK hynix says packaging choice changes how much mechanical and thermal stress an HBM stack must absorb, comparing TSMC CoWoS-S and CoWoS-L with Intel's EMIB.
why: If packaging method drives HBM yield stress, packaging choice becomes a real constraint on accelerator output, not just a cost question.

impact.mechanism: Packaging-induced stress on HBM cubes and interposers affects assembly yield, linking packaging technology choice to deliverable accelerator volume.

evidence.excerpt: packaging choice changes how much mechanical and thermal stress the HBM stack must absorb

confidence.basis: Single secondary conference write-up; no filing or vendor document corroborating.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend rising -> unknown); sources: Intel Newsroom, ServeTheHome
